integrity: Analytical rank-two symmetric-linearization proof; symbolic determinant identities and numerical finite-difference checks supplement but do not replace the proof. Historical priority has not been independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Finite all-to-all real mean-field coupling, common intrinsic frequency, zero amplitude-dependent frequency shift, active set strictly separated from threshold, exact polygon closure. Linear spectral inertia only; no global basin or nonlinear collinear stability assertion.
title: Exact inertia of balanced polygonal Stuart–Landau waves under real mean-field coupling
